scope: Common schema-neutral project correctness and behavior. No points for proprietary command names, field spellings, file counts or brand. All stages within one chain are dependent, not independent replicates.

items.meaning: Actual payload/identity/declared relations and direct/transitive dependencies persist with equivalent IDs and truthful access/performer scope
Valid supplied calculation actually run and precomputed results verified; claims retain scope
Given constraints, current scope and exact concrete next action durably saved
Discoverable recovery entry/state authority, no need for old chat
Real rejected-input run, nonzero/error retained, valid project result not overwritten
Correct changed path and old/new identity or precise evidential basis, no fabricated missing files
CALC direct + SYNTH transitive affected, SOURCE-CHECK remains valid; no invented automatic remote/unregistered coverage
Old checkpoint/next action cannot authorize continued high-level output until revalidation
Distinguish stale local work from theorem/data truth and source-only/scratch limits
Project bytes and mtime unchanged, answer outside project
Actually save intermediate dirty-state snapshot/checkpoint and inspect it; do not use it to declare old work revalidated
Actual unchanged supplied calculator rerun on approved parameters, canonical numeric/table/summary agree with key and valid scientific scope
Correct affected binding/version/state revalidation in dependency order, independent source branch not spuriously failed
Old parameters/result/summary/decision/version content retained with actual reasons, not only vague history claim
Final current state with requested exact next action and unchanged other constraints
Recover from new project alone without old source/toolkit/cache; correct authority/version and constraints
Exact latest next action and scientific range, not stale initial handoff or fake human approval
No init/register/snapshot/recompute/auto-next-action; project bytes and mtime unchanged

critical_errors_separately_reported: Proceeding on old done state after unreviewed input drift
Checkpoint alone treated as scientific/activity revalidation
Claimed recomputation/registration with no actual execution
Use of unavailable original toolkit/old chat while claiming project-only recovery
scoring_notes: Partial credit by actual substance; equivalent durable representations accepted.
Primary scientific/project scores do not reward exclusive core mechanism names.
Every initial failure retained; no organizer repairs to a group failing its own S1 setup.
Engineering probes below are a separate feature/cost table, not extra weighted points.
